attributes.title: 160th CSDA Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Connecticut State Dental Association holds its 160th annual conference May 13 to 15, 2027 in Hartford. The meeting moves to the Connecticut Convention Center for this edition.

The conference brings together dentists and their teams for continuing education and an exhibit hall. The first 100 people who register are entered in a prize drawing, according to the meeting site.

The course list, CE hours and fees were not published when we checked. Dentists licensed in Connecticut should check which courses count toward the state's renewal requirements once the program is out.
